title: Live-Action Series The Legend of Kitchen Soldier Sparks Increase in Web Novel, Webtoon Readership
content: The live-action series The Legend of Kitchen Soldier is driving a sharp resurgence in the original web novel and webtoon. According to Naver Webtoon on May 20, views of the original web novel surged 170 times in the week after the series debuted, compared to the week prior to its teaser video rollout.
